item.title: Scrap 1.0.0
item.description:
# Scrap v1.0.0 (build 10)
Scrap's first public release. Scrap for iPhone is coming to the App Store soon. If you use both, keep them on the same version.
Scrap is a simple notepad in your menu bar, with a page for each day of the week. It always opens on today, so you can jot something down straight away. Last week's notes stay where you left them, and you can plan ahead for the days coming up.
- Open it from the menu bar or with your own keyboard shortcut - Headings, bold, links and checklists - See when you wrote each line - Add text from any app with Services, or drag it onto the menu-bar icon - Add notes with Shortcuts and Siri - Print a note, or save it as a PDF - Search older notes in the Archive - Pick up where you left off on your iPhone with Handoff - Keyboard shortcuts for each day - Syncs with iCloud - Daily backups - Updates itself - Support for macOS accessibility settings - No account, no ads, no tracking - Your notes are yours
